scope: Local synthetic safe-text microbenchmark, three fixed-order repetitions. Every regex match requires one of seven literal prefixes; directory alternatives reject directly and suspected token text still uses the original regex over the entire input. Input with a suspicious prefix is not claimed faster. Whole-package before/after duration includes different cache/run conditions and is descriptive, not a causal CI speedup. This changes publication scanning only: no model weights, inference kernel, language accuracy, codegen throughput, GPU or host CPU claim. No new model/native/Go generated-program executions or training steps.
